locationPlatePrompt.promptText: A background plate from a stylized 3D animated feature film: storybook look, simplified chunky shapes with soft rounded edges, smooth clean materials, gently saturated colors. 16:9 widescreen environment plate, completely empty of people. Room: a small kindergarten classroom on a sunny morning, completely empty of people. A large soft rug in the centre foreground patterned with bright teal, sunflower-yellow and grass-green shapes, with twelve square carpet mats in mixed bright colours laid out in loose uneven rows, slightly scuffed and not perfectly aligned. Behind it, a low bookshelf of open cubbies painted in alternating yellow, teal and orange, stacked with picture books lying at angles. A warm white wall above it covered edge to edge with children's crayon drawings taped up unevenly at different heights, the paper curling at the corners. A hand-lettered paper banner reading "MY FAMILY" is strung across the wall above the drawings in thick uneven marker capitals, drooping slightly in the middle. Secondary detail receding into depth: low tables with small stacking chairs in bright blue and green on the left, a coat rack with colourful empty pegs and one forgotten cardigan, a small aquarium tank on a low stand on the right with green plants and clear water. Lighting & Atmosphere: soft warm morning sunlight streaming from unseen tall windows on the left casting long gentle shadows across the floor. Warm ambient daylight bounce. Camera: 35mm wide shot at adult chest height looking down at the carpet staging area, level horizon, deep depth of field. Exclusions: completely empty of people, no humans, no silhouettes, no crowds, no other text, no posters, no alphabet strips, no charts, no writing on walls.
